about: The full cosmetics catalogue except the Season Pass rewards (those are in season/season_N.json). kind: outfit, face, hair, skin, backdrop, namePlate, richListFlair, tradePlate or saveSlot. rarity: common, rare, epic, legendary. source: store (sold for gold and dropped by boxes), box (only from boxes), collection (reward for finishing a collection), plan (given by a Ledger plan), free (owned from the start), level (value = player level), rank (value = rank number), goal (value = career goal id). theme: optional look theme id from themes/item_themes.json; a theme whose season has not started is hidden everywhere. founderEdition and bound: optional true. art: the art slot name for the picture, drawn as a placeholder until the file exists. style / motion: how a plate or flair looks. retired: items no longer given out; they stay here so saves that own them still load. Store prices are in pricing/prices.json (by rarity); legendary items are box-only.
